description:
Verify a point-in-time snapshot hash

Say whether a snapshot_hash names figures Arche served, and for which company and date. No API key is needed: anyone given the hash from a point-in-time response, such as the reviewer of a figure quoted from it, can check it. verdict is MATCHES when Arche served those figures and NOT_FOUND when it never did. A served snapshot is never changed, so its hash still matches after a later correction changes that date's answer. The hash is the whole request, so a caller can check what they were given and nothing else. The figures themselves are returned by GET /v1/edgar/as-of/{date}/financials/{cik}, which takes a key.

snapshot_hash.description: The snapshot_hash from a point-in-time response.

name: query_verify_snapshot
